title: chore: upgrade @objectstack packages to v3.0.9 and update ROADMAP
body:
Bumps all `@objectstack/*` dependencies from `^3.0.8` to `^3.0.9` and updates ROADMAP.md to reflect new protocol capabilities.

### Version bump

- 42 version references across 14 `package.json` files updated
- `pnpm-lock.yaml` regenerated — all packages resolve to 3.0.9
- UI sub-export (`@objectstack/spec/ui`) is **unchanged** between 3.0.8 and 3.0.9 — no breaking changes

### ROADMAP updates for v3.0.9 protocol

New "Spec v3.0.9 Upgrade Summary" section with capability matrix covering:

- **Workflow/Automation (P1.6):** `parallel_gateway`, `join_gateway`, `boundary_event` node types; BPMN interop; wait/timer executors; execution tracking (`ExecutionLog`, `Checkpoint`); conditional edges; enhanced retry (`backoffMultiplier`, `maxRetryDelayMs`, `jitter`); `FlowVersionHistory`; `ConcurrencyPolicy`
- **Data Export (P1.3):** `ExportFormat` enum, `CreateExportJobRequest`, `ExportJobStatus` for async streaming exports
- **ProcessDesigner (P2.1):** New node type and conditional edge support items
- **Spec Compliance (P2.4):** BPMN interop types, `NodeExecutorDescriptor`, `inputSchema`/`outputSchema` on flow nodes, `boundaryConfig`, App `engine` field, package upgrade protocol
